title.value: Learning What You Need from What You Did: Product Taxonomy Expansion with User Behaviors Supervision
title.justification: The paper's title is extracted directly from the document provided and accurately represents its focus and content on product taxonomy expansion.
title.quote: Learning What You Need from What You Did: Product Taxonomy Expansion with User Behaviors Supervision

extractions.description: This paper presents a self-supervised and user behavior-oriented framework for expanding product taxonomies in e-commerce. It leverages user-generated content and click logs to infer hyponymy relations and append new concepts to existing taxonomies.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is enhancing product taxonomies for e-commerce through user behavior analysis, without specific focus on climate or ecological sustainability issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: product taxonomies serve an essential role in the e-commerce domain for the recommendation, browsing, and query understanding.
